established.lesson: Use official clipped weighted Pearson for model and hyperparameter selection whenever feasible. Lower residual MSE does not imply higher WP.
Point-gradient cosine is unreliable at the current64-sequence search size: median split-half agreement was0.16 for t0 and0.07 for t1. Include sequence uncertainty before rejecting a representation.

Frozen t1 corrections improve all-required-row WP but regress officially scored WP. Their paired population contrasts exclude zero, survive unclipped prediction and within-sequence checks, and remain negative after influential-sequence deletion.

A nonlinear causal mask predictor improved target0 population-gradient transport over the linear predictor under a prospective uncertainty rule. This supports a bounded weighted-readout experiment, not a new incumbent.
